title: org fleeting JSON output
description: Schema for the JSON output of 'org fleeting list' and fleeting note capture commands.

count.description: Total number of matching fleeting notes found.

items.description: List of discovered Luhmann fleeting note items.

file.description: Path to the target Org file where the note was captured.

line.description: One-based line number of the captured heading.

locator.description: Canonical OrgLocator addressing the captured note.

id.description: Optional deterministic RFC 9562 UUIDv5 :ID: assigned to the note.

title.description: Heading title of the captured note.

file.description: Filesystem path to the containing Org source file.

line.description: One-based line number in the source file.

captured_at.description: Formatted capture timestamp string ([YYYY-MM-DD Day HH:MM]).

attached_medium.description: Optional attached medium node link or citation string.

medium_location.description: Optional source location (page, chapter, or section).

attached_zettel.description: Optional attached parent Zettel link or node query.

source_file.description: Optional path to source code or document that sparked the thought.

permanent_note.description: Optional link to permanent Zettel if reformed.

task_note.description: Optional link to GTD task if converted.
